method.claim_boundary: descriptive whole-process allocation attribution only; no phase, latency, speedup, or adoption claim
method.conservation: exact size->count comparison against heaptrack_print allocation-size.histogram plus trace, footer-call, and requested-byte totals
method.decoder: decode_heaptrack_raw_v2.py: implicit string/IP/trace/allocation-info indices; + references allocation-info index; fail-closed missing references and string-length checks
method.direct_caller: for each disjoint trace aggregate, skip the first allocator/reallocator frame when identified; otherwise retain first frame under allocator_frame_not_found; aggregate each trace exactly once
method.stack_evidence: full trace-aggregates.jsonl remains externally bound per child; top 50 trace stacks are copied into this compact receipt

scope.attribution: whole-process heaptrack allocation events; direct-caller groups are disjoint by trace_id
scope.phase_attribution: unavailable: run_scenario is inlined into run_capture and heaptrack has no frozen phase markers
scope.requested_bytes: allocation size from heaptrack a/+ records before frees; not allocator metric deltas or latency
scope.unknown: unknown caller group is only unresolved/missing stack attribution; whole-process setup, correctness, and release activity remain included
